scenarios.name: Consistent relation
scenarios.purpose: Evaluate the stability of a direct association.
scenarios.expected_behavior: X and Y exhibit a clear positive association that remains stable across the sample.

scenarios.name: Confounded relation
scenarios.purpose: Evaluate an association explained primarily by a confounder.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The apparent X–Y association decreases substantially after controlling for Z.

scenarios.name: Outlier-sensitive relation
scenarios.purpose: Evaluate sensitivity of an association to extreme values.
scenarios.expected_behavior: A small extreme subset materially changes the global X–Y association.
